collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who cuts their hair once a year asks a friend who has never cut hair to do it this time.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) cuts (subject.his/her) hair once a year, on the same day, and not one day sooner. Today is the day. Usually (subject.he/she) does it (subject.him/her)self with a sharp shell, but this year (subject.he/she) asks (friend) to do it. (friend) has never cut anyone's hair. (friend) agrees anyway.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) works slowly and with tremendous concentration, tongue sticking out. When (friend.he/she) finishes, one side is definitely shorter than the other. (subject) looks at (subject.his/her) reflection in the water for a long time. "I like it," (subject.he/she) decides, and means it. It will all grow out by next year anyway.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) explains exactly what (subject.he/she) wants, in great detail, with drawings in the sand. (friend) follows every instruction. The haircut is exactly the same as every other year. (subject) is perfectly happy. (friend) is a little disappointed (friend.he/she) didn't get to be more creative.
